sources.fact: Draft London Plan consultation closes 15 October 2026; examination is upcoming and plan is not finalised
After consultation the Mayor may modify the draft and intends submission to Secretary of State in 2027 before Examination in Public
Indicative programme targets formal publication of new London Plan in March 2028; timetable elements outside GLA control
Current London Plan is 2021; next London Plan is in draft consultation with adoption indicated for early 2028
Barking and Dagenham 2037 Local Plan adopted 18 September 2024 and is starting point for decision-making
Draft Annex A monitoring KPIs are proposed monitoring framework, not current parcel facts
Draft policies must not override current adopted development plan before adoption
Draft may change after consultation and before independent examination
Consultation feedback informs plan before independent examination
Consultation materials remain active and not adopted policy
IIA and HRA accompany the draft consultation but do not convert draft policies into adopted rules
Adopted LBBD Policies Map/local plan retains decision-making primacy at borough level alongside current London Plan

examples: Current London Plan remains 2021 until replacement adopted
No promotion using draft policy as current adopted rule
